scenarios.title: Shared database down
scenarios.description: The cache can answer hits, but every miss reaches the crashed database.

scenarios.title: Slow shared database
scenarios.description: Three APIs feed one database whose injected slowdown affects every cache miss.

scenarios.title: One API goes down
scenarios.description: The load balancer still sends part of the traffic to the crashed API.

scenarios.title: One slow API
scenarios.description: One branch runs five times slower while the other two keep serving.

scenarios.title: Full web app outage
scenarios.description: Crash the balancer, all three APIs, the cache and the database. Watch each fault clear in turn.

scenarios.title: Database down
scenarios.description: Crash the database, then watch requests recover.

scenarios.title: Slow database
scenarios.description: Make the database five times slower while traffic keeps moving.

scenarios.title: Slow deployment
scenarios.description: An API setting has jumped from 25ms to 500ms per request.

scenarios.title: Bad database deploy
scenarios.description: Half of database requests fail because of an edited error setting.

scenarios.title: Traffic surge
scenarios.description: Four times the original traffic exposes the database bottleneck.

scenarios.title: Everything breaks
scenarios.description: Both services crash just as demand quadruples.
